enabled_scope: host and definition opt-in published-interval/1; non-qualified locale-snapshot/1; complete/empty publication to first tracked semantic change; half-open certified interval, honest gap rejection, independent valid_at projection and current permission/erasure guards

proof.boundary: Original candidate/interpretation/document/query/definition-policy write UoW closes old coverage; metadata and semantic write commit or roll back together.
proof.inputs: Open interval binds immutable point, semantic unit, query slot barriers and actual source interpretation/document head digests. A later publication cannot seal a changed, untracked input as unchanged.
proof.clock: Trusted common UTC domain for writers/publication. Backdated writer invalidates prior intervals, reader behind ledger frontier rejects intervals, and publication before frontier rolls back. Exact immutable checkpoints remain available under their original current-security contract.
proof.no_change: Current authority/grant renewal and valid-time transitions do not change historical semantic coverage.
proof.access: Current authority/floor, past/current reader and purpose, every actual source grant, completion and erase checks precede archived L1/L0 bodies.
proof.erase: Shared object/scope deletion and backup replay erase all affected facet interval certificates, including earlier empty coverage.
proof.backend_contract: Optional DerivedCoverageUnitOfWork/write-hooks/1; all writers must be upgraded and share the clock domain before enablement. No old/new mixed writers or direct low-level SQL mutations are supported.

tests.architecture: Existing history orchestration boundary case now covers both history.py and coverage.py.
tests.real_sigkill_matrix: candidate/query/publication before/after commit × both backends; older fault and crash regressions also run
tests.accounting: Final targeted run only; no prior-stage or obsolete architecture parameter names counted. Installed reruns are separate.
